title: finding(changeset): the polarity census now exists and its first ten adjudications yield 1-in-10 — the grade condition objectui#9727 was given lands on neither arm, and a 61-entry schema-absent bucket is unadjudicated
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, as the **carrier** for what card objectui#9727 leaves open.

⚠️ **Why a new card and not a re-shape of objectui#9727.** PR objectui#9752 carries `Fixes #9727`, so that card **closes on merge**. The instrument it asked for is delivered; the question its measurement RAISED is not, and would close with it. ⭐ This lane's standing rule — 「一次 PASS 明确留开的东西必须有自己的载体」 — applies to a measurement's own open question exactly as it does to a review's.

## What now exists

`pnpm census:changeset-polarity` (`scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs`, pinned by `scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts`). It runs from a clean checkout with plain `node`, depends on no worktree, and takes `--corpus` / `--types` so it can be run **at a historical ref** — which is what a BORN FALSE verdict requires.

⭐ Its proven blindness is closed and pinned: run against the pre-repair text of the site that motivated objectui#9727, it returns exactly the four keys objectui#9713 adjudicated, every one reached **across a sentence boundary**. The fixture carries that text so the pin survives a shallow clone.

## ⛔ The number is no longer a number

objectui#9727 carried **154 contradictions across 53 entries**, transcribed and marked NOT MEASURED. The rebuilt census reads **134 across 58** — fewer contradictions, MORE entries, so it is not a correction in one direction.

⇒ ⛔ **this card carries no cardinal.** The figure is whatever `pnpm census:changeset-polarity` prints today. Writing it here would re-create, in this card, the exact defect the family is about.

## The open question — ⛔ triage's to answer, ⛔ not this seat's

The grade condition objectui#9727 was given is binary:

> 重建 P/V 后,抽 10 条做完整裁决。真阳率显著非零 ⇒ 这是一份缺陷清单 ⇒ **p2 坐实并可拆条派发**;真阳率≈0 ⇒ 这张卡应当**改形**为「修仪器」。

**The measurement does not land on either arm: 1 true positive in 10 entries** (2 flags of 17). It is not zero — the one positive is real, BORN FALSE, established at its own write-time ref, and is filed as **objectui#9753**. So the existence question stays answered. But it is not a rate that supports splitting 58 entries into dispatchable items.

**This seat's reading, offered and ⛔ not decided:** re-shape toward *"attack the instrument's named false-positive sources, then triage its output"*, keep the class at p2, and ⛔ stop carrying any defect count. At a 1-in-10 yield, splitting 58 entries dispatches roughly fifty no-ops, each costing a history read — ⭐ **the same measurement error in a new coat.** The three false-positive sources are now named and individually attackable; polarity-by-keyword is the cheapest and would have cleared four of the nine false positives in this sample.

## ⛔ A second bucket nobody has adjudicated

**61 matched assertions name a schema symbol this tree does not declare at all.** The census reports them **separately** from contradictions — deliberately, because *"the schema is gone"* and *"the key is absent"* are different facts. That is the shape of objectui#9713's instance 2 (a claim attributed to a retired arm). ⛔ Nobody has adjudicated this bucket, and it is material to whatever this card becomes.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT ask for

- ⛔ Not a sweep of the flagged entries. ⚠️ **裁决必须先于触碰**: ROTTED and BORN FALSE take opposite repairs, and BORN FALSE can only be established at the write-time ref.
- ⛔ Not a repair of any changeset body. `.changeset/5632-…` is **objectui#9753**'s, and it has a closing window.
- ⛔ No `domain:*`, no `priority:*` claimed here beyond the lane this is filed in — grading is triage's.
